title: Figure 37. Atlas Launch Summary (bar chart, 1955–1995)
description: Stacked bar chart of Number of Atlas Missions per Launch Year from about 1957 to 1995, with solid black segments for "Normal Performance" and white segments for "Failure/Anomaly". Launch counts peak in the early-to-mid 1960s at roughly 45–47 per year. Text above describes Atlas propulsion (LOX/RP-1, Castor IVA motors, Centaur and Agena upper stages). Captioned "Figure 37. Atlas Launch Summary".
